title.suggested: McCoole-Allen Match Called Off Without Forfeit

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that a match between Mike McCoole and Tom Allen set for the 17th was drawn without forfeit, and that Allen would challenge the winner of McCoole and Joe Coburn.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Democrat. Thursday Morning, March 12, '68.'

facts.fact: A match made by friends of Allen and Mike McCoole for March 17, 1868 was drawn without any money forfeited; $310 had been put up by backers, none by the principals
Allen intended to challenge the winner of the McCoole-Coburn fight, or accept McCoole's offer to fight for $2,500 if McCoole beat Joe Coburn

notes: The paper says Allen had already made hosts of friends in St. Louis who would back him (March 1868).
